sloka: तेषां गुप्तिपरीहारै: कच्चित्ते भरणं कृतम् ।रक्ष्या हि राज्ञा धर्मेण सर्वे विषयवासिन: ॥ २.१००.४९॥
transliteration: teṣāṁ guptiparīhārai: kaccitte bharaṇaṁ kṛtam ।rakṣyā hi rājñā dharmeṇa sarve viṣayavāsina: ॥ 2.100.49॥

translations.english: I trust, you keep the women pacified and wellprotected, you do not believe their words and do not divulge any secrets to them.
